subject: N-42 narrowcast eval — acceptance gates & contingency runway
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Alex Martinez <alex_martinez@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: partner-oncall@edgeops.io
Date: 2027-08-22T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: N-42 narrowcast eval — acceptance gates & contingency runway

Team —

We need to lock the acceptance gates and contingency runway for the N-42 narrowcast eval that ACME will start next week. Moving fast on this, so I want a short, concrete checklist we can hand to EdgeOps for canary traffic and to CS for customer comms. Attached: n42-prompt-variants.csv (prompt families + sampling plan) and metric-definitions.md (proposal).

Key asks:
- Product: confirm primary business metric (is it ACME "task success rate" or our semantic-f1?) and the relative weight we should use in the combined acceptance score.
- Eng/Inference: confirm canary gating thresholds and how we will measure regressions in live traffic (metric latency windows, rolling window size).
- Evals/Quality: provide a tight list of promptset A/B pairs to run and the specific test harness/seed set we will use for acceptance.

My proposed acceptance criteria (initial draft):
1) No more than 1.5% absolute drop in ACME task_success_rate (30k sample rolling baseline).
2) No more than +3% absolute increase in hallucination-rate on the agreed hallucination testset.
3) Latency P95 <= 420ms additional overhead vs current model (5-minute rolling).
4) No new semantic regressions flagged by the automated comparator (semantic-f1 delta > 0.02 triggers manual review).

Contingency runway (if any of 1–4 fail):
- Immediate capacity to revert to last-stable promptset + model variant (automated fallback within 10 min).
- Escalation to on-call inference and PM. If degradation persists for >30 minutes, pause canary and trigger postmortem.

Schedule I'm proposing:
- 08/25 08:00 PST: start 1% canary (1 hour), check metrics.
- 08/25 09:30 PST: if green, move to 5% for 2 hours.
- 08/25 12:00 PST: if green, move to 25% for 6 hours.
- 08/26 09:00 PST: full ramp if green.

I want owners and small edits to the gates by EOD today so we can finalize the runbook for EdgeOps.

Thanks —
Karthik
Head of Product, Model Serving
Redwood Inference

Attachments: n42-prompt-variants.csv, metric-definitions.md

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>

Subject: Re: N-42 narrowcast eval — acceptance gates & contingency runway

Karthik — thanks for the concise draft. A couple quick notes and additions from the eval side:

- Please add the exact staging traffic fraction we will mirror to the test harness (I recommend 2% mirror + 100% synthetic).
- We'll need the seed set id and the random seed for reproducibility; otherwise A/B noise will be hard to interpret.
- Acceptance check should include automated QA checks for "instruction-following" collapse (we saw this in M-19). I'd like a specific metric: instruction-following pass rate on the 500 high-sensitivity items.

Proposed tweak to contingency runway: instead of immediate rollback at first trigger, prefer a short hold + targeted prompt rollback for the affected prompt family if the regression is localized (faster and less disruptive). Full rollback only if multiple prompt families fail or a customer-critical metric is impacted.

I'll push the seed-set and the 500 sensitive items list to the drive link and update metric-definitions.md.

Marissa
Lead, Eval & Quality
Redwood Inference

Adding infra/metrics perspective. I attached canary-config.yaml with specifics on rolling-window sizes and sample counts. Key clarifications and numbers:

- Rolling windows: use a 30-minute sliding window with 5-minute step for primary metrics, with anomaly detection disabled for the first 60 minutes of each percent-step during the ramp.
- Minimum sample sizes: for the 1% canary we expect ~4.5k requests/hour based on ACME traffic; that's borderline for detecting small deltas — rely on our staging synthetic run for statistical power on semantic-f1.
- Thresholds (suggested concrete values, aligned with Karthik/Marissa):
  * Task_success_rate drop > 1.5% (absolute) on 30k rolling baseline => fail
  * Hallucination-rate increase > 3% (absolute) on the hallucination testset => fail
  * Instruction-following drop > 4% on the 500-sensitive items => localized remediation recommended
  * Request P95 latency overhead > 420ms => fail

Operational playbook:
- If a localized prompt family triggers instruction-following drop (>4%), run targeted prompt rollback for that family (edge-config change) and re-evaluate after 30 minutes.
- If multiple families fail or task_success_rate drops beyond threshold, auto-fallback to last-stable and notify on-call + PM.

Emma (ACME) — FYI we will share the canary-config and the metric-definitions doc after your sign-off on the schedule.

-Alex
Senior Metric Engineer, Redwood Inference

Attachments: canary-config.yaml
